display.purpose: Single-post title in a post header. One per page.

headline.purpose: Page titles on archive and tag pages.

title.purpose: Post-card titles in lists; site title in the header.

subhead.purpose: h3 inside body prose. The serif→sans switch is the section break.

body.purpose: All long-form prose. Capped at 68ch via --measure.

meta.purpose: Dates, byline, captions, callout body, archive timestamps.

label.purpose: Site nav, page-label kicker, post-nav prev/next labels, archive year header. Always uppercase, letter-spaced.

motion.name: ease-quick
motion.purpose: Color/opacity transitions on links, nav, hover states.

motion.name: scroll-smooth
motion.purpose: html { scroll-behavior: smooth } — anchor jumps glide.

components.name: Tag
components.description: Inline uppercase amber pill for taxonomy. The only filled chip in the system.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; padding: 2px 0.5rem; border-radius: 4px; background: oklch(0.96 0.03 70); color: oklch(0.52 0.12 65); text-decoration: none; }

components.name: Site Nav Link
components.description: Uppercase grotesque label, muted at rest, accent on hover.
components.css: .ds-sitenav { display: flex; gap: 3rem; justify-content: center; } .ds-sitenav a { font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 500; color: #6b6b68; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; transition: color 0.15s; } .ds-sitenav a:hover { color: oklch(0.52 0.12 65); } .ds-sitenav a[aria-current="page"] { color: #1a1a18; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Post Card with Star Separator
components.description: The signature list item. A serif title and meta, separated from the next entry by a hairline crossed by an amber ✦.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-postcard { display: grid; gap: 0.5rem; padding-block: 0; } .ds-postcard--next { padding-top: 3rem; position: relative; } .ds-postcard--next::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 1px; background: #e5e5e3; transform: translateY(-50%); } .ds-postcard--next::before { content: '\2726'; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); padding: 0 0.75rem; background-color: #fafaf8; color: oklch(0.52 0.12 65); font-size: 0.55rem; line-height: 1; z-index: 1; } .ds-postcard__title { font-family: Vollkorn, Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.75rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: -0.01em; margin: 0; } .ds-postcard__title a { color: #1a1a18; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.15s; } .ds-postcard__title a:hover { color: oklch(0.52 0.12 65); } .ds-postcard__meta { font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #6b6b68; } .ds-postcard__excerpt { font-family: Vollkorn, Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1.6; color: #6b6b68; max-width: 68ch; margin: 0; }

components.name: Callout
components.description: Quiet amber-tinted aside. Used sparingly for context the prose can't carry.
components.html: Posts in this archive predate the current redesign and may render imperfectly.
components.css: .ds-callout { background: oklch(0.96 0.03 70); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, oklch(0.52 0.12 65) 25%, transparent); border-radius: 8px; padding: 2rem; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; color: #1a1a18; max-width: 68ch; margin: 0; } .ds-callout p { margin: 0; }

components.name: Blockquote with Floating Quote Glyph
components.description: Italic Vollkorn pulled-in quote with a single oversized opening quote mark in faded accent at the left edge — the only ornament inside body prose.
components.html:
The quieter the room, the better the photograph.

— Found note, undated
components.css: .ds-blockquote { position: relative; padding-left: 3rem; color: #6b6b68; font-style: italic; max-width: 68ch; font-family: Vollkorn, Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1.6; margin: 0; } .ds-blockquote::before { content: '\201C'; font-family: Vollkorn, Georgia, serif; font-size: 2.5rem; line-height: 1; color: oklch(0.52 0.12 65); opacity: 0.35; position: absolute; left: 0; top: -0.1rem; } .ds-blockquote cite { display: block; margin-top: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-style: normal; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Post Nav (prev/next tiles)
components.description: Two bordered tiles for previous/next post. Hairline border shifts to accent on hover.
components.html: PreviousNotes from the darkroomNextA walk with the Leica
components.css: .ds-postnav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 1rem; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-postnav__tile { text-decoration: none; padding: 1rem; border: 1px solid #e5e5e3; border-radius: 8px; display: grid; gap: 0.25rem; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-postnav__tile:hover { border-color: oklch(0.52 0.12 65); } .ds-postnav__tile--next { text-align: right; } .ds-postnav__label { color: #6b6b68; font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-postnav__title { color: #1a1a18; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.35; }

components.name: Status Block
components.description: Compact metadata strip at the foot of an entry. Small uppercase keys, plain values.
components.css: .ds-status { font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #6b6b68; background: oklch(0.96 0.03 70); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.52 0.12 65) 15%, transparent); border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.25rem 1rem; } .ds-status ul { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; } .ds-status li { line-height: 1.5; } .ds-status strong { font-weight: 600; color: #1a1a18; font-size: 0.7rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; margin-right: 0.5rem; }

components.name: Inline Code
components.description: Mono inside prose, with a quiet wash background.
components.html: Run npx eleventy --serve in the project root.
components.css: .ds-prose { font-family: Vollkorn, Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1.6; color: #1a1a18; margin: 0; } .ds-code { font-family: 'SF Mono', 'Fira Code', Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.875em; background: #f3f4f6; padding: 2px 5px; border-radius: 4px; color: #1a1a18; }

narrative.overview: baty.net is set like a small-format hardcover: warm off-white pages, a bookish serif body, deliberate margins, and a single hand-mixed accent the color of old ink. The system is light-first; the dark mode is a faithful night-table version of the same book, never a separate identity. Decoration is rationed — when a flourish appears (a ✦ between entries, a floating quote glyph, an amber tag) it is the only flourish on the page. The site rejects the visual vocabulary of tech blogs, SaaS marketing, and AI-generated dashboards.
keyCharacteristics: One accent in the warm-amber/honey family, used on ≤10% of any page.
Bookish serif body (Vollkorn) paired with a clean grotesque (Hanken Grotesk) for chrome and metadata.
Generous reading measure (68ch) with a 1.6 line-height.
A single ornament — ✦ — separates list items where a hairline would feel mechanical.

rules.name: The 10% Accent Rule
rules.body: The amber accent is rationed. It appears on links, the active hover state, the post-card ✦ separator, the floating quote glyph, and the tag pill. Adding it to a sixth surface dilutes it.

rules.name: The No-Pure-White, No-Pure-Black Rule
rules.body: #fff and #000 are forbidden. Every neutral is tinted toward the paper hue. Use the tokens.

rules.name: The Tinted-Neutrals Rule
rules.body: Borders and dividers are 1px in --color-border, sometimes mixed at 50% via color-mix. Never a colored stripe.

rules.name: The Single-Serif Rule
rules.body: All long-form prose is Vollkorn — display, body, blockquote, captions inside posts. Hanken Grotesk is for chrome only.

rules.name: The 68ch Rule
rules.body: Body paragraphs and figures cap at var(--measure) = 68ch. Notes use a tighter 60ch. Wider than 75ch breaks the bookish rhythm.

rules.name: The Uppercase-Label Rule
rules.body: Anything in uppercase uses Hanken Grotesk, weight 600, letter-spacing 0.1em (or 0.05em for the smallest variants). Uppercase serif is forbidden.

rules.name: The Flat-Paper Rule
rules.body: Surfaces sit on the page, never above it. If you reach for box-shadow, you're solving the wrong problem — try a hairline, a tint, or more space.

rules.name: The Hairline-Only Rule
rules.body: All borders are 1px. Sometimes mixed at 50% transparency via color-mix. Never a colored accent stripe.

dos: Do keep #fff out of the source. Page bg is #fafaf8; surface is white only when an element must sit above the page.
Do ration the amber accent. If it's already on the link, the tag, the ✦, the quote glyph, and the hover state — the sixth use is one too many.
Do use Vollkorn for prose and Hanken Grotesk for chrome. Never mix them inside a single paragraph.
Do cap reading measure at 68ch via var(--measure) (or 60ch for note variants).
Do use the ✦ separator pattern between list items where a hairline alone would feel mechanical.
Do prefer a hairline (1px solid var(--color-border)) or a tint (--color-accent-soft) over any new structural device.
Do float small thumbnails right at 100×100, with shape-outside: border-box. On ≤600px viewports they break out of the float and center.
Do test every change in dark mode via prefers-color-scheme. Light is primary; dark must match the same restraint.
donts: Don't use #fff or #000 anywhere. Every neutral is tinted toward the paper hue.
Don't introduce a second accent. The system has one. If a state needs distinction, use weight, size, or muted color — not a new hue.
Don't use gradients. Anywhere. Not in backgrounds, not in text, not on borders.
Don't use side-stripe borders (border-left greater than 1px as a colored accent). The blockquote uses an absolutely-positioned glyph for the same purpose — copy that pattern.
Don't use box-shadow. The system is flat. If you reach for elevation, the answer is more whitespace, a hairline, or a tint.
Don't use glassmorphism, blur backdrops, or any frosted surface effect.
Don't build hero-metric tiles, identical-card grids, or icon-headline-text card walls.
Don't build anything that reads as a tech blog, SaaS landing page, or AI made this.
Don't use uppercase serif. Uppercase is always Hanken Grotesk with letter-spacing 0.05em–0.1em.
Don't use em dashes in copy. Use commas, colons, semicolons, or parentheses.
Don't add a CSS framework, utility-class layer, or component runtime. The single styles.css is the system.
Don't let chrome compete with photographs. When an image is present in a post, surrounding elements step back.
